protocol.name: v7-eye-centre-sampling-preflight-v1

phase_motion_protocol.name: v7-phase-balanced-motion-v1
phase_motion_protocol.aggregation: float64 phase-average then cycle-average before per-cell contrast
phase_motion_protocol.reference: same-frame gray sham; static grating reported separately

protocol.sampler: local_x=2*u-(side>0); x=local_x*(half_width-1); y=v*(height-1); bilinear within same eye only
protocol.protocol_revision: After input-control failure, neural evaluation was removed; analytic periodic-state diagnostic added without changing gates.

sampling_controls.scope: sampler algebra and receptor-only controls, not neural mirror equivalence

synthetic_controls.scope: synthetic assay controls, never injected into neural populations

fractional_phase_diagnostic.filter: independent linear filter, leak=0.24, four substeps/frame
fractional_phase_diagnostic.initial_state: analytic periodic fixed point, not finite warmup
fractional_phase_diagnostic.scope: post-failure scoring diagnostic; mean-square not adopted as neural metric

neural_evaluation.reason: Input-only preflight; neural comparison requires valid sampled controls.

limitations: Post-inspection diagnostic, not independent final validation.
Scaling, interpolation and boundaries change together; no boundary-only attribution.
Sampler reflection identity does not establish neural symmetry or retinotopy.
Bilinear interpolation is an engineering rule, not a measured receptive field.
Fractional sampling interacts with rectified discrete cycle scoring; periodic-state negative control still fails without any neural spatial computation.
Mean-square control does not establish a valid general neural direction metric.
No neural model was fitted or evaluated; default services and policies unchanged.
